headline: Amazon writes scary blog warning communities not to block data centers
summary: Amazon warns blocking AI data centers risks harm to the US economy and national security. The CEO addressed concerns about jobs and power demands in a lengthy blog post. Amazon urges communities to support these critical infrastructure projects.

headline: AI music maker Suno now generates spoken words
summary: Suno has expanded beyond AI music, launching a new feature for generating spoken voices. This public beta allows users to create voiceovers from scripts or prompts. The platform can also generate background music to accompany the speech.

headline: Apple’s reportedly developing a smart home camera that doesn’t record video
summary: Apple is rumored to be developing a smart home security camera that will not record video footage. Instead, it will provide users with text descriptions of events. This camera is expected to be part of a new Apple smart home ecosystem.

headline: Google’s new Guided Vision feature can help you read the fine print
summary: Google's Guided Vision, launching in Gemini Live, offers real-time audio descriptions via your phone's camera. It uses AI to help with tasks like reading small text, describing surroundings, and identifying objects. The feature is available on compatible Android devices.

headline: 'I've Buried It Deep': X-Men Actor Says He Knew Sony's Spider-Man Spinoff Kraven Wasn't 'Going Well' During Filming
summary: X-Men actor Christopher Abbott admits he knew Sony's 'Kraven the Hunter' spinoff was struggling during filming. He sensed early on that the Spider-Man movie wasn't 'going well'. Abbott said he 'buried deep' his feelings about the production.

headline: With a Smirk, Robert Pattinson Calls Michael Bay's Transformers 'The Definitive Movie of the 2000s'
summary: Robert Pattinson jokingly called Michael Bay's Transformers the 'definitive movie of the 2000s'. He made the comment with a smirk during an interview about favorite films. The actor's statement appeared on A24 and Letterboxd's YouTube show.

headline: Modder Deliberately Corrupts Their Own Hugely Popular Total War: Warhammer III Mod as Row Over AI Escalates
summary: A popular Total War: Warhammer III mod has been deliberately corrupted by its creator. The modder acted in protest against unauthorized reuploads and AI-generated modifications. This incident marks an escalation in the ongoing debate over AI in modding.

headline: The 10 Most Valuable Cards in Magic: The Gathering Reality Fracture
summary: This article details the ten most valuable cards in Magic: The Gathering's new 'Reality Fracture' expansion. It highlights expensive Facet Foil chase cards and rare Echoverse hits. The breakdown helps players identify top-tier collectibles.

headline: 'I was not going to let others die' - pilot of Flydubai flight describes cockpit attack by co-pilot
summary: Flydubai Captain Smit Machchhar recounted a harrowing cockpit attack by his co-pilot. He opened the cockpit door, allowing passengers to intervene and overpower the attacker. The pilot's decisive actions prevented further harm.

headline: Watch: Emotional pilot recounts moment of Flydubai attack
summary: An emotional pilot recounted the moment his co-pilot attacked him mid-flight. He is hailed a hero for opening the cockpit door, allowing passengers to overpower the assailant. The incident occurred on a Flydubai flight.

headline: Man City lodge appeal after being found guilty of breaching financial rules
summary: Manchester City has lodged an appeal after being found guilty of breaching financial rules. The club's statement claims the ruling contains 'clear material errors.' They assert the decision is 'unsafe' due to these inaccuracies.

headline: Christa Pike in critical condition after surviving two lethal injections, lawyer says
summary: Christa Pike is in critical condition after reportedly surviving two lethal injection attempts. Her lawyers have requested a commutation of her death sentence. They argue the botched execution warrants a review of her case.
